title: zainab mera bhai margaya
body:
zainab mera bhai margaya
lakar alam abbas ka
qaimein jis dam rakh diya
ek shor matam ka utha
roro ke shey ne kaha
zainab mera bhai margaya (3 times)
1. woh quwate baazu mera
shane kata kar so gaya
kaisa sitam hum per huwa
raas aayi na karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
2. ahle haram hain nouhagar
mashko alam ko dekh kar
chup hain sakina qaak par
kistarha samjhaye pidar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. veeraan hai sara jahan
mara gaya bhai jawaan
hain dhoop mein laasha waha
hum hain yaha mehve fuga
<<DIVIDER>>
4. har saans hain nouha kuna
aankhon se aansoo hain rawa
sookhe labon par hain fuga
kis se karo main yeh baya
<<DIVIDER>>
5. ankhon se tapkey hain laho
jine ki ab kya aarzoo
tegh-o-sina ke roo baroo
tanha hain hum pesh-e-adoo . . . .
